description: YOLOv8L branch (Table XI, left column). Ultralytics 8.4.18 training arguments as used; data/project/device are set by train_yolo.py.

notes.batch: 8 tiles per step; nbs 16 makes Ultralytics accumulate gradients over 2 steps (effective batch 16, Table XI)
notes.augmentation: no geometric, mosaic, flip or colour augmentation; brightness (HSV value) jitter 0.15 is on
notes.early_stopping: patience counts epochs without an improvement of at least 0.001 in validation-tile mAP50:95
notes.checkpoint: best.pt: highest validation-tile mAP50:95 (latest epoch on ties)
notes.loss_precision: float32 detection criterion with mixed-precision forward (symbolrec/patches.py)

HandSchA.tiles: prepare_yolo.py --dataset HandSchA (sampler seed 20261021 for every run)

MUSCIMA++.initialization: official COCO yolov8l.pt (Ultralytics builds the 73-class head)
